Warren "Wazza" Ackary (born September 27, 1959) is an Australian professional darts player who currently plays in the World ParaDarts (WPD) events and formerly of the Professional Darts Corporation (PDC) tournaments. His the nickname called Wazza.
Career
Ackary played in the 2010 PDC Pro Tour events of Sydney, Australia, before losing to the preliminary round with Malaysia's Abdul Ghani Amin by 6 legs to 3.
Ackary played events in the World ParaDarts (WPD) since July 2025 of Australia.
